title: CBDT Notifies New Rules for Merger of Registered Non-Profit Organisations Under Income Tax Rules 2026
content:
# CBDT Notifies New Rules for Merger of Registered Non-Profit Organisations Under Income Tax Rules 2026

Ek important update hai. Government ne registered non-profit organisations ke merger ke liye Income Tax Rules 2026 ke तहत naye niyam announce kiye hain.

*   **What's New:** Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne registered non-profit organisations ke merger se related naye rules notify kiye hain. Isse amalgamation process mein clarity aur transparency aayegi, ensuring a structured approach for such transactions.
*   **Notification Details:** Yeh rules Income Tax Rules 2026 ke under hain aur Notification No. 139/2026 dated October 30, 2026, ke through announce kiye gaye hain. This notification outlines the specific procedures and conditions that non-profit organisations must follow when merging.
*   **Why it Matters:** These rules aim to streamline the compliance mechanism for merging non-profit entities, ensuring a smooth transition while adhering to income tax provisions. Isse non-profit sector mein ease of doing business improve hoga aur regulatory complexities kam hongi.
